title: fix(app-shell): list a package's draft objects in the Access matrix, badged as drafts
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8VtLrLYVCgWS9LRTX72qamP)_
Fixes #26840

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 包内的访问矩阵现在也列出该包的草稿对象,并在行上标出「(草稿)」;草稿对象的字段也能展开。
- 为什么改:原来只列已发布对象,新包的对象都是草稿时矩阵显示「0 个对象」,首次发布前无法配置权限。
- 风险与回滚:只改包作用域下的三处读取(对象列表、字段读取两处),环境作用域不变;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` 的对象列表读取与 `readObjectDefinition`;新测试 `PermissionMatrixEditor.draftObjects-26840.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.draftObjects-26840`,预期 5 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- Under a `packageId`, the matrix lists its objects through `MetadataClient.withPreviewDrafts(true)` (the `?preview=draft` door the object picker's `useObjectCatalog` uses), so a package whose objects are all drafts lists them instead of "0 objects".
- A row served from its pending draft (`_draft: true`, the picker's signal) carries the picker's draft mark: a muted `data-draft-marker` span reading `engine.inspector.draftSuffix` ("(draft)" / "(草稿)"), in both the page table and the Studio layout. No new marker, no new i18n key.
- The two per-object definition reads (field rows in `ensureFields`, and `loadObjectFields` for the RLS and field-condition CEL editors) go through the same door under a `packageId`, via one helper `readObjectDefinition`. Without it a draft-only object expands to "no fields".
- Environment scope (Setup catalog, no `packageId`) keeps the published reads unchanged; only the package door authors drafts. Pinned by a test that asserts no preview read and no draft row there.
- Test doubles that mount the matrix under a package gain `withPreviewDrafts() { return this; }` (the Studio tests' existing precedent); five typed doubles widen `FakeClient` to `=> unknown` because that method returns the client, not a promise.

## Why

Triage ruling 6450953786: list draft objects too (with `preview=draft`), badged as drafts, so a new package can be secured before its first publish.

## Tests

- New: `PermissionMatrixEditor.draftObjects-26840.test.tsx`, 5 tests: a draft-only object is listed and badged (page and Studio layouts); a published object has no badge; toggling the draft object's Read writes `objects.a_invoice.allowRead` into the set draft (`mode: 'draft'`, `packageId: 'app.a'`); its fields come from its draft; the environment door keeps the published list.
- Scoped run (every app-shell test that mounts the matrix: 41 importers of `PermissionMatrixEditPage` plus 35 `StudioDesignSurface` tests naming the Access pillar, 73 files after dedupe): Test Files 73 passed, Tests 690 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: exit 0.
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit 1 to 0, blob f8f9c813 to 36feb5f1 and back, `git diff HEAD` empty after restore): replacing the package-door list read with plain `client.list` turns 4 of the 5 new tests red; the environment-door test stays green, as it should.

## Acceptance notes

- PR #26999 (#26858) edits this same file and was still open when this PR was opened; `origin/main` was merged into this branch twice, the last time at `3230bdbf`.
- A published object with a pending draft is also served with `_draft: true` and so carries the draft mark, the same as in the object picker.
- The full app-shell suite (1,816 files) was not run locally; it belongs to CI. The scoped set above is every file that mounts the matrix.

## Verification

Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`) and their exits are in the os-dev report on #26840.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (CI)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (`@object-ui/app-shell` is private: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (except the six-line maintainer brief the dispatch order asks for in Chinese)
